notes.title: Bulletmancer 1.3 - New Character!
notes.notes:
A new Bulletmancer has joined us: Faericus, the Traveler! Unlock him by absorbing a total of 100 fairies and then beat a run with him to unlock a new spell.
Full changes:

[list]
[*] Added a new character: Faericus, the Traveler. His ability increases his stats permanently when absorbing fairies. Remember that increasing your Luck makes fairies appear more often!
[*] Added a new spell, Queen of the Fae. It makes fairies become Rainbow Fairies that grant all the buffs of the other fairies when absorbed.
[*] Fixed a bug where buttons in the main screen where still clickable after opening the option menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.3
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused the display of your current spells to stop working after picking up a spell you already had and a bug that caused the windowed mode to not work for some users.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.2
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that messed with the text of the messages shown when you unlock a feature and tried a new fix for the reocurring bug of bosses sometime not dying, causing the run to never end.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused some spell descriptions to not show properly.

notes.title: Bulletmancer 1.2 - The Spellbook
notes.notes:
Second major update to Bulletmancer is here! The two biggest news are that you can now play the game in spanish and a new feature that was requested many times: The Spellbook! A place where you can check all the data related to the spells of the game. Here are the full notes:

-Full translation of the game to spanish.
-Added the Spellbook, where you can see all the spells in the game, their descriptions and the conditions to unlock them if you haven't done it yet.
-Added a new spell, the Unstable Orb, an orbital that randomly explodes over time. You can unlock it by beating a run with Boominicus (so now she is in line with the other bulletmancers. Oopsie!).
-Improved the way your current collected spells are showed in game.
-Fixed a bug that made Abra Kaboom don't work with Boominicus.
-FIxed a bug that made the window automatically resize after ending a run if you had the game on Windowed mode.
-Fixed a bug where if you had Shrapnel Mines and Pin Missile the texture of the bullets wasn't correct.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.4
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where if bosses died to Thorns damage the run wouldn't end.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.3
notes.notes: Fixed a bug preventing players to unlock the achievements Avatar and Veggie.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.2
notes.notes: Fixed a bug preventing players to get the achivements for beating Forestia and Ancient Mountain at corruption level 10.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused the special ability of Arengynicus to not work as intended and changed the font color in stat descriptions to be more readable.

notes.title: Bulletmancer 1.1 - VIsual Update
notes.notes:
First content update for Bulletmancer is here! It includes a new feature many of you asked for that will provide more information about the build you are creating each run, along with some upgrades to the clarity and visual side of the game and an important bugfix related to the option menu.

Patch notes:
-Now you can see the upgrades you currently have while pausing the game and leveling up.
-Improved attack animations for many enemies.
-Stat scaling in upgrades is now marked with a specific color for each stat.
-"Vampirism" upgrade now includes a unique design for your cannon in line with the other Legendary upgrades.
-"Splash" upgrade now correctly says "deal 25% of your Attack" instead of 10%.
-Fixed a bug that caused the options you changed in the option menu to not be saved after closing the game.

notes.title: Bulletmancer - Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
There was an important error that made some runs impossible to beat, this patch fixes it. We want to thank the players that gave us feedback and we hope you continue helping us making the game more enjoyable. We also added to the patch a little improve to the clarity of Glyphs' description text.

-Fixed a bug causing runs to not end if the boss was killed with damage over time effects like Fireball.
-Clarified Glpyhs' description text explaining scaling.

notes.title: Problems with demo save files
notes.notes: A bug related to demo save files caused errors in the games of people who played the demo, we tried to fix it without making you lose old progress but we haven't found a way to do it that doesn't cause even bigger problems. Last update fixes the issue but doesnt preserve demo data, sorry to all of you and we hope you can enjoy the game even if starting from scratch.

notes.title: Bulletmancer - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: An update fixing games not working properly when having a save from the demo is out, sadly it implies losing all demo progression, we are still working to find a solution that preserves your save. thank you all for your patience.

notes.title: Bulletmancer is out!
notes.notes: Thanks to all the people that played the demo, gave feedback and supported us, Bulletmancer is finally out! We hope that you enjoy it, make some ridiculously broken builds and continue helping us to make the best game possible :D

notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.notes:
The demo of our game Bulletmancer is out for you to play!

The game is still in an early stage of development so you can expect new content, bug fixes, QoL updates and general improvements to the experience while we are working on it.

[h3]Demo features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]3 Characters
[*]9 Enemies
[*]50+ Spells
[*]First map: Forestia
[*]First final boss: Four Guardians
[*]First two corruption levels to increase the challenge
[*]First four Glyphs to upgrade your characters
[/list]
If you enjoy the game you can support us by wishlisting it or spreading the word so more people can learn the way of Bulletmancy.
